ValidationRule.description: Validation to ensure required price review is created before moving a contract to signed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated"),ISPICKVAL(Sector__c, "Drivetech"), ISPICKVAL( Contract_Type__c , "Master Contract"), OR( Number_of_Price_Reviews__c = 0, ISNULL(Number_of_Price_Reviews__c ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure you have created a price review record before moving your contract to activated.
